From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 readiness: portfolio signals & exec attention log

Team —

Attaching the working QBR watchlist (see file: QBR_watchlist_2026-12-10.xlsx). I ran a quick sweep of accounts we should consider for exec attention over this QBR window. Quick summary/highlights: 

- NimbusCloud (renewal Q1): largest at-risk ARR ($2.3M). Procurement is pushing new SLO language; they've asked for a 12-month committed pricing ask and a credit if latency exceeds 95th pct SLO.
- Stratus (pilot expanding): promising but delayed PO due to a security evidence request (SOC2 artifacts & data retention notes).
- Aurora Analytics (expansion): support SLA escalations around long-response inference tails; finance asking for unit-cost breakdown for the ask.
- Two mid-market accounts showing usage drop (listed in sheet under "watch - engagement" tab).

Proposed immediate actions: 
1) Executive cover for NimbusCloud — recommend a one-time retention credit (6%) tied to an ROI commitment and an offer for a Dedicated capacity pilot for one month. Need approval from finance and exec to offer.
2) Assign a single owner for Stratus compliance ask so we can turn evidence requests into a checklist (SOC2 + sample logs). Marissa, can your team own shepherding that?
3) Schedule a 30-min QBR rehearsal Thursday Dec 16 10:00 PST (calendar link below) — please block if you are on the exec attendance list.

Notes: I've flagged the rows that are 'exec escalation' in the spreadsheet. There are draft talking points in the QBR "talking_points" sheet for Nimbus and Stratus.

Attachments: QBR_watchlist_2026-12-10.xlsx
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4392

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Soojin — thanks for the concise list. Quick responses inline.

> NimbusCloud (renewal Q1): largest at-risk ARR ($2.3M).
Agree we should offer a targeted retention credit tied to outcomes. I support a 6% credit contingent on a one-year commit and a pilot Dedicated cluster for 30 days.

Action: Finance (cc) — please confirm budget runway for the credit and pilot costs. Hannah, can you scope the Dedicated pilot SOW and estimate delta?

> Stratus (pilot expanding): delayed PO due to security evidence request.
Marissa — please confirm we can produce the SOC2 artifacts and a short data-retention note. If legal needs to push any redline, loop me.

I'll be on the rehearsal if it's Dec 16; please send calendar invite.
